test_title: PYST 1: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 16th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6b3584f027a640b4a2ccb1e0818576616d7e3ea96f67fa6c55f3db7e268cc0a.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) Square rotates in a clockwise direction each corner in a box and one by one square part becomes dark in a clockwise direction

2) Line rotate in a clockwise direction and one by one line increase.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d0d0437e0dbe639612536ec6eda33a470953ec465785b0c4abea0f50d81176c.png] 

Final series is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1966a80958baab0d7a0c0cbfb2214629323aa6bcac60af3cd0ebe0973451ba5.png] 

Hence, **‘option 3’** is the correct answer.
